description:
## Pepper PL 8.13.02 prebuilt variants

Maintenance release: **patches and `.mpp` bundle are byte-equivalent to v1.0.0** — the only change is a fresh set of four prebuilt XAPKs targeting Pepper PL **8.13.02** (versionCode 81302) instead of 8.13.00.

If you build through Morphe Manager / `morphe-cli` you can keep using v1.0.0's bundle — there is no patch delta. The new release exists so that anyone grabbing a ready XAPK doesn't have to start from the old 8.13.00 base.

> 📦 **Also on ReVanced** → [pepper-revanced-patches v1.4.1](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — same patch set, upstream [ReVanced Patcher](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patcher) bundle for [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager).

### What changed in Pepper 8.13.02 (upstream)

Diffed against 8.13.00 — the delta is one new feature plus the usual build-time noise. **None of it touches any patch's fingerprint surface**, so every patch from v1.0.0 applies unchanged:

| Layer | Change |
|---|---|
| New feature | **Views Challenge** — weekly-visit Club-points streak system: 15 new `views_challenge_*` strings, 1 plural, 1 vector drawable (`branding_mascot_smiling.xml`), corresponding DEX |
| Strings | +15 in base APK; same 15 translated in `config.de` / `config.es` / `config.fr` splits (+4 KB each) |
| `AndroidManifest.xml` (decoded) | **no semantic change** |
| Permissions | **no change** |
| `target_sdk` / `min_sdk` | 36 / 24 — unchanged |
| Noise | Crashlytics `mapping_file_id`, `version-control-info.textproto` revision, R8 service renames (`c95→e95`, `i18→r18`, `rr2→sr2` under `META-INF/services/`), regenerated `baseline.prof` / `baseline.profm` |

All 14 patches apply cleanly. Verified end-to-end against the APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants

Same 2×2 matrix as v1.0.0 (debug menu × compact cards):

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Each XAPK ships:
- patched **base** APK (DEX-rewritten, all default-on patches applied)
- `config.arm64_v8a` + `config.xxxhdpi` splits
- `config.en` + `config.pl` language splits

For any other ABI / DPI / language combo, grab the matching split from the unpatched APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK and side-load alongside via `adb install-multiple`.

### Patches in the bundle (unchanged from v1.0.0)

| # | Patch | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Enable debug menu | **opt-in** | Re-enables the hidden 3-dot debug menu (45 dev actions). |
| 2 | Unlock tier-locked icons | on | All 12 membership-tier icons available in the picker. |
| 3 | Hide banner ads in feed | on | Pubmatic / DFPBanner ads never load; empty cell collapsed. |
| 4 | Always show event-theming icons | on | All 4 event icons available regardless of the active event. |
| 5 | Keep event icon after restart | on | Chosen event icon stays after the event ends. |
| 6 | Fix spacing around hidden ad cells | on | Companion to patch #3. |
| 7 | Compact deal cards | **opt-in** | Resource-only XML edits to deal-list cards + skeletons. |
| T1 | Redirect tracker URLs to localhost | on | dex string-pool rewrite — Iterable, Pepper Ocular, Usercentrics, Adjust, Vungle, Pubmatic, FB, GMA. |
| T2 | Neuter tracker auto-init ContentProviders | on | Vungle, Adjust, FB Audience Network. |
| T3 | Kill Pepper first-party pixel tracking | on | NOP pixel worker + mock hwid (32-char MD5-hex format). |
| T4 | Kill Datatransport upload pipeline | on | Crashlytics + Firebase logging upload jobs. |
| T5 | Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init | on | NOP `MobileAds.initialize`. |
| T6 | Disable GMA ad-load entry points | on | NOP every `loadAd*` on AdLoader / AdManager / RewardedAd. |
| T7 | Disable Adjust SDK | on | NOP every state-mutating `Adjust.*` static method. |
| T8 | Disable PAIRIP license check | on (`com.pepperdeals` only) | Sideloaded US build can open. |
| T9 | Skip Usercentrics consent screen | on | CMP screen + fetch wait → straight to notif prompt. |
| T10 | Block Pepper analytics-event-report tracker | on | Retrofit `@POST` rewrite to `http://127.0.0.1:1`. |

See [v1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.0.0) for the full visual diff of compact deal cards and per-element XML breakdown.

### Files

- `patches.mpp` / `patches-1.0.1.mpp` — patch bundle for [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) / [morphe-cli](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-cli) (functionally equivalent to v1.0.0)
- `patches-list.json` — patch metadata for Morphe Manager
- `manifest.json` — Morphe Manager source URL pointer
- `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` — vanilla telemetry-blocked Pepper PL
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` — + debug menu
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` — + compact cards
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` — + debug menu **and** compact cards

Install the XAPK with SAI / APKMirror Installer / Morphe Manager.

### Compatible with

All 10 sister apps from the family (Pepper PL, NL, DE, UK, FR, MX, ES, AT, SE and the US `com.pepperdeals` build). T8 is restricted to `com.pepperdeals` (only that build ships PAIRIP).

release_notes:
## Pepper PL 8.13.02 prebuilt variants

Maintenance release: **patches and `.mpp` bundle are byte-equivalent to v1.0.0** — the only change is a fresh set of four prebuilt XAPKs targeting Pepper PL **8.13.02** (versionCode 81302) instead of 8.13.00.

If you build through Morphe Manager / `morphe-cli` you can keep using v1.0.0's bundle — there is no patch delta. The new release exists so that anyone grabbing a ready XAPK doesn't have to start from the old 8.13.00 base.

> 📦 **Also on ReVanced** → [pepper-revanced-patches v1.4.1](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — same patch set, upstream [ReVanced Patcher](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patcher) bundle for [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager).

### What changed in Pepper 8.13.02 (upstream)

Diffed against 8.13.00 — the delta is one new feature plus the usual build-time noise. **None of it touches any patch's fingerprint surface**, so every patch from v1.0.0 applies unchanged:

| Layer | Change |
|---|---|
| New feature | **Views Challenge** — weekly-visit Club-points streak system: 15 new `views_challenge_*` strings, 1 plural, 1 vector drawable (`branding_mascot_smiling.xml`), corresponding DEX |
| Strings | +15 in base APK; same 15 translated in `config.de` / `config.es` / `config.fr` splits (+4 KB each) |
| `AndroidManifest.xml` (decoded) | **no semantic change** |
| Permissions | **no change** |
| `target_sdk` / `min_sdk` | 36 / 24 — unchanged |
| Noise | Crashlytics `mapping_file_id`, `version-control-info.textproto` revision, R8 service renames (`c95→e95`, `i18→r18`, `rr2→sr2` under `META-INF/services/`), regenerated `baseline.prof` / `baseline.profm` |

All 14 patches apply cleanly. Verified end-to-end against the APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants

Same 2×2 matrix as v1.0.0 (debug menu × compact cards):

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Each XAPK ships:
- patched **base** APK (DEX-rewritten, all default-on patches applied)
- `config.arm64_v8a` + `config.xxxhdpi` splits
- `config.en` + `config.pl` language splits

For any other ABI / DPI / language combo, grab the matching split from the unpatched APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK and side-load alongside via `adb install-multiple`.

### Patches in the bundle (unchanged from v1.0.0)

| # | Patch | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Enable debug menu | **opt-in** | Re-enables the hidden 3-dot debug menu (45 dev actions). |
| 2 | Unlock tier-locked icons | on | All 12 membership-tier icons available in the picker. |
| 3 | Hide banner ads in feed | on | Pubmatic / DFPBanner ads never load; empty cell collapsed. |
| 4 | Always show event-theming icons | on | All 4 event icons available regardless of the active event. |
| 5 | Keep event icon after restart | on | Chosen event icon stays after the event ends. |
| 6 | Fix spacing around hidden ad cells | on | Companion to patch #3. |
| 7 | Compact deal cards | **opt-in** | Resource-only XML edits to deal-list cards + skeletons. |
| T1 | Redirect tracker URLs to localhost | on | dex string-pool rewrite — Iterable, Pepper Ocular, Usercentrics, Adjust, Vungle, Pubmatic, FB, GMA. |
| T2 | Neuter tracker auto-init ContentProviders | on | Vungle, Adjust, FB Audience Network. |
| T3 | Kill Pepper first-party pixel tracking | on | NOP pixel worker + mock hwid (32-char MD5-hex format). |
| T4 | Kill Datatransport upload pipeline | on | Crashlytics + Firebase logging upload jobs. |
| T5 | Disable Google Mobile Ads SDK init | on | NOP `MobileAds.initialize`. |
| T6 | Disable GMA ad-load entry points | on | NOP every `loadAd*` on AdLoader / AdManager / RewardedAd. |
| T7 | Disable Adjust SDK | on | NOP every state-mutating `Adjust.*` static method. |
| T8 | Disable PAIRIP license check | on (`com.pepperdeals` only) | Sideloaded US build can open. |
| T9 | Skip Usercentrics consent screen | on | CMP screen + fetch wait → straight to notif prompt. |
| T10 | Block Pepper analytics-event-report tracker | on | Retrofit `@POST` rewrite to `http://127.0.0.1:1`. |

See [v1.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.0.0) for the full visual diff of compact deal cards and per-element XML breakdown.

### Files

- `patches.mpp` / `patches-1.0.1.mpp` — patch bundle for [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) / [morphe-cli](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-cli) (functionally equivalent to v1.0.0)
- `patches-list.json` — patch metadata for Morphe Manager
- `manifest.json` — Morphe Manager source URL pointer
- `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` — vanilla telemetry-blocked Pepper PL
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` — + debug menu
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` — + compact cards
- `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` — + debug menu **and** compact cards

Install the XAPK with SAI / APKMirror Installer / Morphe Manager.

### Compatible with

All 10 sister apps from the family (Pepper PL, NL, DE, UK, FR, MX, ES, AT, SE and the US `com.pepperdeals` build). T8 is restricted to `com.pepperdeals` (only that build ships PAIRIP).
